text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is coming up soon. As
the
tension builds, we celebrate the
holiday season...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Happy Holidays, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, did I surprise you? I did all this
while you
were out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I didn't just decorate your room, either!
There's
also a carrot cake!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to thank you for everything you
do for
me. So, once again—Happy
Holidays, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm glad that brought a smile to
your face.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It feels like you've been really tense
lately...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You helped me out so much.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's why I really wanted to do
something for
you now.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to thank me! This is just
as much
for me as it is for you!
choice_data_list: 俺のために、ありがとう
私のために、ありがとう

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I know we probably don't have the time
to take
our foot off the gas with such a
big race ahead of
us...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But I wanna cherish this special time with
you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
We've got a race coming up, and it's one
I can't
lose. I wanna bring everything I've
got to the race
so I can win!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanna spend the day with
you and—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eek! T-trainer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, I will!
choice_data_list: “この時間”も、レースに持っていこう！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All righty! Let's dig into this cake! I'll
slice it up!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it looks super tasty! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Aww... I really wanna, but I understand.
Not with
my big race being so soon!

We enjoy a memorable evening
together. It's a
nice change of pace
before heading into the
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It's kinda strange...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've... I've never spent the holidays like
this
before.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
With the Arima Kinen right around the
corner, I'm
really on edge...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But... this is fun. I'm having a really good
time!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Today, I just wanna be the Umamusume
who has
the most holiday fun in all of
Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So let's do a whole lotta celebrating
together,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
First, we can have some cake. And
then... Oh, I've
got Santa hats that we
can wear!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
We'll eat chicken, and then, and then...
Gah,
there's so much I wanna do!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I like the sound of that!
choice_data_list: 思いつくことを全部やるぞ！
思いつくことを全部やろう！

text_block_list.text:
We enjoy a memorable evening
together. It's a
nice change of pace
before heading into the
Arima Kinen.
